hook_line: SACHIN TENDULKAR INVESTS IN RECYCLING PLATFORM
diaspora_bullets: Recykal is private - no public share to buy
news_summary: Sachin Tendulkar has joined Hyderabad-based waste-management platform Recykal as a strategic investor, extending its $23 million bridge round.
payoff: Recykal remains private, so there is no listed-market action to take.
